capabilities.name: Safe work-copy mutation
capabilities.whatItDoes: Allows document edits only after a saved MASTER is copied, verified, and opened as an authorized work copy.

capabilities.name: Deterministic object selection

statusDefinitions.INTEGRATED_PUBLIC: Implemented and exposed after applicable validation.
statusDefinitions.PUBLIC_CANDIDATE: Fused internally; deferred from new public registration pending the Phase 2.3 Illustrator validation.
statusDefinitions.INTEGRATED_INTERNAL: Fused, fixed internal operation or retained DPM primitive; not independently exposed.
statusDefinitions.LICENSE_BLOCKED: Potential source exists but its exact revision lacks a verified compatible license.
statusDefinitions.TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED: No safe reusable implementation is available without creating new undocumented Illustrator behavior.
statusDefinitions.DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED: Genuine DPM-specific core workflow creation remains required.
statusDefinitions.NEWER_ADOBE_DEPENDENCY: Requires newer or private Adobe services with no reusable Illustrator 26.1 replacement.
